name: blades_create_booking
description: Create a real Blades Hair Cal.com booking. Use only after a live slot was returned and the caller explicitly confirmed the complete booking. Success requires ok=true and bookingUid.

eventTypeSlug.description: 15min for consultation/short visit; 30min for standard appointment.

start.description: Exact ISO 8601 start returned by blades_check_availability.

attendeePhone.description: Caller's confirmed mobile; UK or Pakistan national format is accepted.

attendeeEmail.description: Optional email. Omit when the caller did not provide one.

attendeeTimeZone.description: Use Europe/London unless the caller gave a different timezone.

notes.description: Include salon service, ladies/gents when known, and requested stylist or 'any'.

callerConfirmed.description: True only after the caller explicitly confirms the readback.
